description: This file contains utility functions for handling repository paths, parsing TypeScript source files for module specifiers, comparing inventory entries, and processing inventory data asynchronously. It appears to support script operations related to inventory management and module dependency analysis in a TypeScript or JavaScript project.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Normalizes a file path relative to the repository root, converting OS-specific separators to '/'.

methods.name: resolveRepoSpecifier
methods.description: Resolves a module specifier to a repository-relative path if possible.

methods.name: visitModuleSpecifiers
methods.description: Traverses a TypeScript source file to identify import, export, and dynamic import specifiers, invoking a callback for each.

methods.name: diffInventoryEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventory entry lists, identifying missing and unexpected entries.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Writes a line of text to a specified stream.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptInventory
methods.description: Asynchronously processes multiple TypeScript files to collect and sort inventory entries.

methods.name: runBaselineInventoryCheck
methods.description: Performs inventory validation against expected data, outputting results in human-readable or JSON format.
